title: The Museum of Unsent Signals
shortDescription: On a museum’s final night, listen to a signal filed as blank.
description: A museum of unsent transmissions is closing for good. Before the relay is switched off, the caretaker asks you to check one wooden spool. It was filed as blank, yet someone handled it every day for forty years. Read the marks along its edge, listen to what it holds, and decide where the signal belongs.
author: AdventureArena
